segments.sn35.149:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamā ca sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā?
segments.sn35.149:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuṃ anattāti passati, rūpā anattāti passati, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattāti passati, cakkhusamphasso anattāti passati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattāti passati … pe … mano anattāti passati, dhammā anattāti passati, manoviññāṇaṃ anattāti passati, manosamphasso anattāti passati, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattāti passati.
segments.sn35.149:1.6: Ayaṃ kho sā, bhikkhave, nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā”ti.

lines: Paṭipāṭiyā pana catūsupi etesu suttesu saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā.
Nibbānasappāyā paṭipadā desitāti katvā “saha vipassanāya cattāro maggā kathitā”ti vuttaṃ.
